learnings: Anchor titles to famous names, known brands, or specific national institutions (e.g., Dangote, Gupta Family, NNPC) rather than anonymous corporate entities.
Retire the repetitive 'Exposed:' hook format, which has caused title blindness and declining click-through rates.
Structure Shorts scripts for seamless looping; hook viewers in the first 2 seconds with high stakes to target >100% average percentage viewed.
Focus long-form videos on empire-building biographies and industrial titan profiles, which proved viable on the Dangote upload (44.5% retention).
Include local currency or concrete figures tied directly to named scandals to provide immediate credibility and curiosity in search feeds.
Avoid back-to-back uploads on nearly identical oil scam angles within 48 hours to prevent self-cannibalization and audience fatigue.
